method.embedding: Resemblyzer VoiceEncoder, bundled pretrained GE2E model, 256 dimensions
method.clips: 22 question clips and 22 cited-response clips, with 5 second context padding
method.audioSource: YouTube format 140 downloaded temporarily on GX10 and converted to 16 kHz mono WAV

findings.kmeansK2: 17 questions + 18 responses in the main cluster; 5 questions + 4 responses in the secondary cluster
findings.q01Observation: The moderator says 謝謝蓮海兄 before the cited response, and the cited text reads like a participant restatement rather than a teacher answer.

limitations: ASR output has no speaker labels.
Voice embeddings do not reliably distinguish teacher from participants in this recording.
A speaker role cannot be assigned from acoustic clustering alone.
publicationDecision: Do not publish teacher summaries until role attribution is independently verified.
